packages.name: @comchatx/cx-assistant
packages.description: Does the work with your plugins, giving reasons and sources.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
This plugin sets how cx works: it works out what to do and does it with your plugins; a proposal comes with one line of reason and its source, and the whole analysis when you ask; a file is named by its title, never pasted into the conversation. The chat keeps to answers and their grounds, and the long version waits until you want it.

Some things you can ask:

- Why do you suggest lowering the price?
- Show me the whole analysis.
- What can you do for me right now?

cx works on cx's computer, which is used by your cx alone, and offers only what your plugins let it do.

## Plugins

Each plugin gives cx one more capability, such as a data source, a model or a skill. Once you install it on the Plugins page, cx can use it, and the plugins it needs are installed with it.

packages.name: @comchatx/cx-board
packages.description: Keeps cx's reports and drafts on a board beside the chat.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
Reports, findings and drafts cx leaves for later go on a board beside the chat. Have cx add tabs, such as one per store.

Some things you can ask:

- Put this competitor analysis on the board.
- Add a tab called "Amazon US" to the board, and put US reports there from now on.
- Turn last week's report on the board into a table.

## Files the board opens

A file named in cx's answer opens on a tab of the board. A Word file shows its headings, text, tables and pictures in the type of cx's answers. An Excel file shows each of its sheets as Excel shows its cells, under a switch of their names, with the values the file saved; its hidden sheets are left out. A PDF shows its pages one under another at the tab's width; pictures stored as JBIG2 or JPEG 2000, and Japanese or Korean text in a font the file doesn't carry, don't show. Links in these files show as text and can't be pressed. A Word, Excel or PDF file that is locked or damaged shows “This file can't be read.”

packages.name: cx-amazon-sp-api
packages.description: Checks orders, stock and fees, and edits listings and prices.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
Connect your Amazon store to cx so it can read your orders, listings, inventory, reports and finances in Seller Central, and make changes for you. cx totals orders and sales by marketplace, finds FBA stock about to run out and listings Amazon flags, breaks down each transaction's fees, and changes listings and prices. Useful for checking each day's sales, tracing fees and fixing listing problems. It connects through SP-API, Amazon's official interface for seller tools, in the regions you authorise.

Some things you can ask:

- What were B0EXAMPLE1's traffic and conversion rate last week?
- Change B0EXAMPLE1's price on Amazon US to $24.99.
- Which fees did Amazon take from last month's sales?

## Connecting your store

On the plugin's Settings, connect a store for each region you sell in: North America, Europe or the Far East. Amazon's guide to self-authorisation shows where to find what Settings asks for. Your keys stay with ComChatX and are never given to cx.

## What it costs

Nothing. Neither Amazon nor ComChatX charges for it.

Useful for checking each day whether your ads pay off, and stopping what spends without selling. It connects through the Ads API, Amazon's official interface for advertising, for Sponsored Products, Brands and Display.

Some things you can ask:

- Which search terms in B0EXAMPLE1's ads led to sales?
- Create an automatic Sponsored Products campaign for B0EXAMPLE1 at $20 a day.
- What was the ACOS of Sponsored Products and of Sponsored Brands last month?

## Connecting your store

On the plugin's Settings, connect a store for each region you advertise in: North America, Europe or the Far East. Settings asks for your Ads API application's details and a Refresh token, and Amazon's guide to authorization grants shows how to get them. Your keys stay with ComChatX and are never given to cx.

## What it costs

Nothing. Neither Amazon nor ComChatX charges for it. What your ads spend is between you and Amazon.

一个飞书群里的自定义机器人，在插件的「设置」里填入它的 Webhook 地址。机器人的安全设置只用自定义关键词；开启签名校验或 IP 白名单后，消息发不出去。

packages.name: @comchatx/cx-schedule
packages.description: Lets cx do things for you at the times you set.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
Tell cx what to do and when, such as summing up yesterday's orders at 9 every morning, and cx keeps it as a scheduled job and does it on time, in the conversation where you asked. Jobs that read your store need your Amazon seller account connected.

Some things you can ask:

- At 9 every morning, sum up yesterday's orders and sales in each marketplace.
- Check B0EXAMPLE1's Buy Box every hour, and tell me if someone takes it.
- Remind me every Friday afternoon to look at the ads report.

## When jobs run

Jobs run only while cx's computer is on, that is, while you use cx or after you turn on Keep it on in Settings. If cx's computer is off when a job falls due, the job doesn't run and doesn't switch it on, and the missed run isn't made up once it's back on. A job set to run once never runs if it's missed. Jobs stay after cx's computer switches off.

## What it costs

You pay for the time cx's computer is kept on, and a job that runs often keeps it on.

packages.name: cx-keepa

packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
cx tells you when your products and rivals' changed price, coupon, Buy Box or BSR, from the day-by-day history Keepa keeps for each product. It also finds products by search, best-seller list or seller. It all comes from Keepa, on 11 Amazon marketplaces.

Some things you can ask:

- Which of my B0EXAMPLE1 and these three rivals changed price or ran a coupon last week?
- What else does the seller who took B0EXAMPLE1's Buy Box sell?
- In this category, which products sell over 1,000 a month with under 100 reviews?

cx finds a product by its ASIN or by its name.

## Marketplaces

Amazon US, UK, DE, FR, JP, CA, IT, ES, IN, MX and BR.

## What it costs

Each product cx reads, and each lookup, is billed to your ComChatX balance; once you save your own Keepa API Key, Keepa bills you for them instead. The plugin's page shows the price of one product, and Usage shows every purchase and its cost.

packages.name: cx-listing-playbook
packages.description: Lets cx review your listings, log each change and tell whether it worked.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
Lets cx look after your Amazon listings and keep a record of every change made to them.

## What cx can do with it

- Give cx an ASIN, and it reads that listing and what Amazon reports on it, says what holds it back, and proposes changes with its reasons.
- For each change, cx writes down the listing before and after, what the change was meant to do, and when Amazon accepted it.
- Some time after a change, cx compares the listing before and after, and tells you whether the change worked, did not, or cannot be told yet.
- Tell cx in your own words how to look after a listing, such as “check it every day and tell me only when something needs changing”, and cx keeps to it.

It reads your listings and Amazon's reports through Amazon SP-API, and uses Keepa's history where it compares a listing with the market.

comchatx.about: 让 cx 检查 listing、记录每次修改，并判断修改是否见效。

- 每次修改，cx 都会记下改前改后的内容、这次修改想达到的效果，以及亚马逊接受修改的时间。
- 修改一段时间后，cx 会对比修改前后的表现，告诉你这次修改见效了、没见效，还是暂时无法判断。
- 用你自己的话告诉 cx 怎样照看某个 listing，比如“每天帮我看一下，有需要改的再告诉我”，cx 会照此执行。

packages.name: cx-sources
packages.description: Buys only the data cx needs, and quotes first if you ask.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
This is the base every data-source plugin stands on: it comes with each of them, and you never install it yourself. It sets how cx gets data from the sources you install: cx reads each source's own guide first and buys only what the answer needs; it quotes the price first when you ask; and data it paid for but did not receive, it fetches again without paying twice. The raw files it buys are kept in one fixed place in your files, so reading them again costs nothing, and the dates and figures in them are worked out by code, not guessed. It also handles changes to your data settings, and the plugins you ask cx to install or remove. Each purchase is charged to your balance and listed in Settings › Usage.

## What it costs

Data Source Core itself is free and needs no setup. Each source you install charges for the data cx buys from it, at the price its own page shows.

## How it installs

It installs with each data source that needs it.

packages.name: @comchatx/cx-s3-storage
packages.description: Stores your images in your own bucket, with links for listings.
packages.author: ComChatX
packages.readme:
To change a listing's main image, Amazon needs a link to the picture that anyone can open. Connect your own cloud storage to cx, and cx stores images and other files there, each with a public link a listing can use as its main image; it can also list, read, copy and delete them. Useful for keeping and sorting product images. Amazon S3, Cloudflare R2 and other S3-compatible storage all work; providers call the place a bucket.

Some things you can ask:

- Store these images in my bucket's listings folder, and give me each one's link.
- Which images are in my bucket's listings folder?
- Copy last year's images in listings to an archive folder, then delete the originals.

## Connecting your bucket

On the plugin's Settings, enter the endpoint, bucket, region, Access key ID, Secret access key and public address. Your provider's guide shows where to find each one. A key limited to one bucket keeps cx to that bucket. Your keys stay with ComChatX and are never given to cx.

## What it costs

Nothing on ComChatX. Your provider bills your own account as usual.
